example_1_simple_smart_turn.name: Simple Smart Turn
example_1_simple_smart_turn.description: Basic smart turn detection with default start strategies
example_1_simple_smart_turn.use_case: General purpose conversations with natural pauses

example_2_prevent_false_starts.name: Prevent False Starts
example_2_prevent_false_starts.description: Require minimum words before starting turn to prevent 'um', 'uh' interruptions
example_2_prevent_false_starts.use_case: Sales conversations where users frequently say filler words

example_3_cloud_based_analyzer.name: Cloud-Based Analyzer
example_3_cloud_based_analyzer.description: Use Fal.ai cloud analyzer instead of local model
example_3_cloud_based_analyzer.use_case: Serverless deployments or when minimizing local compute

example_4_with_muting.name: Smart Turn with Function Call Muting
example_4_with_muting.description: Smart turn detection + mute during function calls
example_4_with_muting.use_case: Conversations with API calls or database queries that need focus

example_5_no_interruptions.name: No Interruptions Allowed
example_5_no_interruptions.description: Mute user whenever bot is speaking
example_5_no_interruptions.use_case: Information delivery where bot message must be heard completely

example_6_elderly_users.name: Elderly/Slower Speakers
example_6_elderly_users.description: Longer timeout for users who need more thinking time

example_7_fast_paced_sales.name: Fast-Paced Sales
example_7_fast_paced_sales.description: Shorter timeout for quick back-and-forth conversations

example_8_simple_transcription_based.name: Simple Transcription-Based
example_8_simple_transcription_based.description: No ML model, just transcription-based turn detection
example_8_simple_transcription_based.use_case: When ML model overhead is unwanted, or for debugging

example_9_external_control.name: External Control
example_9_external_control.description: Turn control managed by external processor
example_9_external_control.use_case: Custom turn logic, STT services with built-in turn detection

example_10_first_greeting_protection.name: First Greeting Protection
example_10_first_greeting_protection.description: Mute user only during bot's first speech, then allow interruptions
example_10_first_greeting_protection.use_case: Ensure bot can deliver initial greeting, then allow natural conversation

example_11_keyword_filter_exact.name: Keyword Filter - Exact Match
example_11_keyword_filter_exact.description: Filter exact keyword matches when bot is busy (speaking, processing, or executing functions)
example_11_keyword_filter_exact.use_case: Prevent repeated greetings when bot is processing response

example_12_keyword_filter_contains.name: Keyword Filter - Contains Match
example_12_keyword_filter_contains.description: Filter keywords using substring matching when bot is busy
example_12_keyword_filter_contains.use_case: Filter impatient user phrases during API calls or long processing

configuration.description: Turn strategies are configured via template JSON only
configuration.step_1: Add turn_strategy_config to your template JSON
configuration.step_3: Configure desired strategies (start, stop, mute, analyzers)
configuration.note: Redis-based configuration (BB_ENABLE_SMART_TURN) is no longer supported
